W.A.No.6466/2017 and W.A.No.849/2018.
This intra Court appeal has been filed against the orders dated 01.10.2012 and 18.07.2017 passed by learned Single Judge in the writ petitions and review petitions respectively.
The dispute in this intra Court appeal pertains to quantum of compensation payable to the appellants, who are the owners of the land.
It is not in dispute that the land belonging to the appellants has been utilized for the purpose of widening of National Highway by the respondents.
3. We have heard learned counsel for the parties at length.

4. Learned Single Judge by a common order dated 18.07.2017 passed in review petitions had directed that "the review petitioners shall be paid compensation in respect of portion of property,
which will be determined by the Authorities within four weeks from today".

It is also not in dispute that the amount of compensation has to be determined with reference to provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 as the land was utilized by the respondents in the year 2008.
5. Consensus have been arrived at between the parties with regard to the dispute before the District Court.

4. Learned Single Judge by a common order dated 18.07.2017 passed in review petitions had directed that "the review petitioners shall be paid compensation in respect of portion of property,
which will be determined by the Authorities within four weeks from today".
5. Consensus have been arrived at between the parties with regard to the dispute before the District Court.

The appellants in any case, if they are aggrieved by the quantum of compensation, which may be determined by the respondents, have a right to seek reference under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act before the District Court.

6. Learned AGA submits that the dispute pertaining to quantum of compensation shall be referred by Deputy Commissioner, Shivamogga for adjudication to the District Court within a period of 4 weeks from the date of receipt of copy of the order passed today.

7. Therefore, in view of consensus arrived at between the parties and in view of the submission made by learned Additional Government Advocate, it is directed that the Deputy Commissioner,
Shivamogga shall refer the dispute with regard to the quantum of compensation to the District Court within a period of four weeks from the date of receipt of copy of order passed today.
To the aforesaid extent, the orders dated 01.10.2012 and 18.07.2017 passed in writ petitions and review - 21 - petitions are modified.
Accordingly, the appeal is disposed of.
